content: Amoxicillin-clavulanate potassium is available in the following formulations: 1. 250 mg/125 mg Tablets: Each white, oval, film-coated tablet is imprinted with AUGMENTIN on one side and 250/125 on the other. It contains 250 mg of amoxicillin (as the trihydrate) and 125 mg of clavulanic acid (as the potassium salt). Packaged in bottles of 30 (NDC 43598-018-30). Also available in unit dose packaging of 100 tablets (10x10) (NDC 43598-018-78). 2. 500 mg/125 mg Tablets: Each white, oval, film-coated tablet is imprinted with AUGMENTIN on one side and 500/125 on the other. It contains 500 mg of amoxicillin (as the trihydrate) and 125 mg of clavulanic acid (as the potassium salt). Packaged in bottles of 20 (NDC 43598-006-14). Also available in unit dose packaging of 100 tablets (10x10) (NDC 43598-006-78). 3. 875 mg/125 mg Tablets: Each scored, white, capsule-shaped tablet is imprinted with AUGMENTIN 875 on one side and has a score line on the other. It contains 875 mg of amoxicillin (as the trihydrate) and 125 mg of clavulanic acid (as the potassium salt). Packaged in bottles of 20 (NDC 43598-021-14). Also available in unit dose packaging of 100 tablets (10x10) (NDC 43598-021-78). 4. Powder for Oral Suspension: 125 mg/31.25 mg per 5 mL: A banana-flavored powder that, when reconstituted, provides 125 mg of amoxicillin and 31.25 mg of clavulanic acid per 5 mL. Available in 75 mL bottles (NDC 43598-012-51), 100 mL bottles (NDC 43598-012-52), and 150 mL bottles (NDC 43598-012-53). 200 mg/28.5 mg per 5 mL: An orange-flavored powder that, when reconstituted, provides 200 mg of amoxicillin and 28.5 mg of clavulanic acid per 5 mL. Available in 50 mL bottles (NDC 43598-013-50), 75 mL bottles (NDC 43598-013-51), and 100 mL bottles (NDC 43598-013-52). 250 mg/62.5 mg per 5 mL: An orange-flavored powder that, when reconstituted, provides 250 mg of amoxicillin and 62.5 mg of clavulanic acid per 5 mL. Available in 75 mL bottles (NDC 43598-004-51), 100 mL bottles (NDC 43598-004-52), and 150 mL bottles (NDC 43598-004-53). 400 mg/57 mg per 5 mL: An orange-flavored powder that, when reconstituted, provides 400 mg of amoxicillin and 57 mg of clavulanic acid per 5 mL. Available in 50 mL bottles (NDC 43598-008-50), 75 mL bottles (NDC 43598-008-51), and 100 mL bottles (NDC 43598-008-52). 5. Chewable Tablets: 125 mg/31.25 mg Chewable Tablets: Each mottled yellow, round, lemon-lime-flavored tablet is imprinted with BMP 189 and contains 125 mg of amoxicillin and 31.25 mg of clavulanic acid. Packaged in cartons of 30 tablets (5x6) (NDC 43598-014-31). 200 mg/28.5 mg Chewable Tablets: Each mottled pink, round, biconvex, cherry-banana-flavored tablet is imprinted with AUGMENTIN 200 and contains 200 mg of amoxicillin and 28.5 mg of clavulanic acid. Packaged in cartons of 20 tablets (NDC 43598-015-14). 250 mg/62.5 mg Chewable Tablets: Each mottled yellow, round, lemon-lime-flavored tablet is imprinted with BMP 190 and contains 250 mg of amoxicillin and 62.5 mg of clavulanic acid. Packaged in cartons of 30 tablets (5x6) (NDC 43598-016-31). 400 mg/57 mg Chewable Tablets: Each mottled pink, round, biconvex, cherry-banana-flavored tablet is imprinted with AUGMENTIN 400 and contains 400 mg of amoxicillin and 57 mg of clavulanic acid. Packaged in cartons of 20 tablets (NDC 43598-017-14). Storage Instructions: Tablets and dry powder should be stored at or below 25°C (77°F). Reconstituted oral suspension should be stored under refrigeration and any unused suspension should be discarded after 10 days. Keep all formulations out of the reach of children.
